q20033.en: The sign shown gives advance warning that you may not continue straight on.

explain.short: It announces that at the next junction you must turn left, so going straight on is not allowed.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia' means 'announces in advance': the obligation starts at the junction ahead.

sceneParams.caption: Ahead: left only, no straight on

q20034.en: The sign shown gives advance warning that you may not turn right.

explain.short: At the junction ahead you may only turn left, so a right turn is not allowed.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'svoltare a destra' (turn right) is excluded because only left is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Ahead: left only, no right turn

q20035.en: The sign shown is placed before a junction.

explain.short: It is an advance warning, so it stands some way before the junction where you must turn left.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'prima di' means 'before': this sign comes before the junction, not at it.

q20036.en: The sign shown comes before a COMPULSORY DIRECTION LEFT sign.

explain.short: First you see this curved-arrow warning, then at the junction the sign 'direzione obbligatoria a sinistra'.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'precede' means 'comes before': the warning sign comes first, the real obligation sign follows.

sceneParams.caption: Warning first, left-only sign at the junction

q20037.en: The sign shown is a mandatory sign.

explain.short: It is a blue round sign: in Italy blue discs give an obligation (obbligo).
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'd'obbligo' (mandatory): blue disc = something you MUST do.

q20038.en: The sign shown is a regulatory sign.

explain.short: Regulatory signs (prescrizione) include both prohibition and mandatory signs, so this blue sign belongs there.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (regulatory) is the big family: prohibitions AND obligations.

q20039.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a one-way street.

explain.short: It announces a compulsory turn to the left, not a one-way street.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) is a different, rectangular information sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not one-way: only left at the junction

q20040.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: It is a blue disc, so it gives an obligation; information signs are usually rectangular.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information) signs only inform; this one orders you.

q20041.en: The sign shown means you must pass to the left of the obstacle.

explain.short: The curved arrow announces a left turn at a junction; the obstacle sign has a straight arrow pointing down-left.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'passare a sinistra dell'ostacolo' is a different sign with a diagonal arrow.

sceneParams.caption: Not an obstacle: a left turn ahead

keywords.en: pass to the left of the obstacle

q20042.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a sloping road.

explain.short: It is placed before a junction to announce a compulsory left turn; slopes have their own danger signs.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'strada in pendenza' (sloping road) has nothing to do with a curved blue arrow.

sceneParams.caption: Before a junction, not before a slope

q20043.en: The sign shown means you must change lane.

explain.short: It means you must turn left at the junction ahead, not change lane.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'cambiare corsia' (change lane) is not what this sign orders.

sceneParams.caption: Turn left ahead, not change lane

q20044.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous bend to the left.

explain.short: A dangerous bend is shown by a red triangle; this blue disc announces a compulsory left turn.
explain.rule: The blue disc with a CURVED arrow is 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of a compulsory direction). It stands before the junction: there you may only turn left.
explain.trap: 'curva pericolosa' (dangerous bend) is a red-triangle danger sign, not a blue disc.

sceneParams.caption: Not a bend: a compulsory left turn

q20045.en: The sign shown means you must continue straight on.

explain.short: The white arrow points up: straight on is the only way you may go.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' means you MUST: here, go straight on.

sceneParams.caption: Only straight on at the junction

q20046.en: The sign shown does not allow a left turn.

explain.short: You must go straight on, so turning left is not allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'non consente' (does not allow): every direction except straight is excluded.

q20047.en: The sign shown, placed before a junction, obliges you to continue straight on.

explain.short: Before a junction, this sign tells you that straight on is the only allowed direction.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'posto prima di un incrocio' is the normal position; 'obbliga' means you must.

sceneParams.caption: Only straight on at the junction

q20048.en: The sign shown, at a junction, does not allow you to turn right or left.

explain.short: Straight on is the only direction, so both right and left turns are excluded.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'a destra o a sinistra': both turns are forbidden, not just one.

sceneParams.caption: No right, no left: straight only

q20049.en: The sign shown indicates the only direction allowed.

explain.short: A compulsory direction sign shows the one and only way you may go: here, straight on.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'unica' (only one): that is exactly what 'direzione obbligatoria' means.

sceneParams.caption: The arrow = the only way allowed

q20050.en: The sign shown is a regulatory sign.

explain.short: Mandatory signs belong to the regulatory signs (prescrizione), together with prohibition signs.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (regulatory) covers both prohibitions and obligations.

q20051.en: The sign shown is a compulsory direction sign.

explain.short: Its name is 'direzione obbligatoria diritto': compulsory direction straight on.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'direzione obbligatoria' (compulsory direction): the arrow is an order.

q20052.en: The sign shown is a mandatory sign.

explain.short: It is a blue disc with a white arrow: blue discs give obligations.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' (obligation): blue round sign = you MUST do it.

q20053.en: The sign shown does not allow a right turn.

explain.short: You may only go straight on, so turning right is not allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'non consente' (does not allow): right is excluded like left.

q20054.en: The sign shown allows you to turn right or left.

explain.short: The arrow points straight up: you must go straight on, so no turns at all.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) is wrong: the sign takes away both turns.

keywords.it: svoltare a destra o a sinistra

q20055.en: The sign shown allows you to turn at the junction.

explain.short: At the junction you must go straight on; turning is not allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'consente di svoltare' (allows turning) is the opposite of the sign.

q20056.en: The sign shown indicates the start of one-way traffic.

explain.short: It only orders you to go straight on; one-way streets have their own rectangular sign.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) is an information sign, not a blue disc.

q20057.en: The sign shown indicates the end of two-way traffic.

explain.short: It does not talk about two-way traffic; it only orders you to go straight on.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'fine del doppio senso' (end of two-way traffic) is not shown by a blue arrow disc.

q20058.en: The sign shown requires driving in single file.

explain.short: It orders straight on at the junction, not driving in single file.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'unica fila' (single file) is a different rule with a different sign.

q20059.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: A blue disc gives an obligation; it does not just inform.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information) is wrong: this is an obligation sign.

q20060.en: The sign shown is a prohibition sign.

explain.short: Prohibition signs have a red ring; this blue disc tells you what you must do.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'divieto' (prohibition) = red ring; blue disc = 'obbligo'.

sceneParams.caption: Blue = must do, red ring = must not

q20061.en: The sign shown is a lane sign.

explain.short: Lane signs are rectangular panels above or beside the lanes; this is a round compulsory direction sign.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'segnale di corsia' (lane sign) is an information panel, not a blue disc.

sceneParams.caption: Not a lane sign: compulsory direction

q20062.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a recommended direction.

explain.short: The direction is compulsory, not recommended: you must go straight on.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'consigliata' (recommended) is wrong: blue discs give orders, not advice.

q20063.en: The sign shown obliges you to turn right or left.

explain.short: The arrow points up: you must go straight on, and turning is not allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'svoltare a destra o a sinistra' is exactly what this sign forbids.

keywords.it: svoltare a destra o a sinistra

q20064.en: The sign shown rules out vehicles coming from the opposite direction.

explain.short: It only tells you which way to go; the road ahead can still be two-way, with oncoming traffic.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'esclude' (rules out) is too strong: the sign says nothing about oncoming vehicles.

q20065.en: The sign shown indicates a one-way street straight ahead.

explain.short: A 'senso unico frontale' is a square information sign; this round blue sign is an obligation to go straight.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria diritto' (compulsory straight ahead) is a blue disc with a white arrow up. At the junction you may only go straight on: no left, no right.
explain.trap: 'senso unico frontale' (one-way ahead) looks similar but is a square sign.

q20066.en: The sign shown means you must turn left.

explain.short: The white arrow points left on a blue disc: you must turn left.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' means you MUST: here, turn left.

q20067.en: The sign shown does not allow you to turn right.

explain.short: You may only turn left, so a right turn is not allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'non consente' (does not allow): every direction except left is excluded.

q20068.en: The sign shown, placed before a junction, obliges you to turn left.

explain.short: At the junction it stands at, the only allowed direction is left.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'obbliga' means you must; 'prima di un incrocio' is where it stands.

q20069.en: The sign shown, at a junction, does not allow you to continue straight on.

explain.short: Left is the only allowed direction, so going straight on is not allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'proseguire diritto' (go straight on) is excluded like the right turn.

q20070.en: The sign shown indicates the only direction allowed.

explain.short: A compulsory direction sign shows the one and only way you may go: here, left.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'unica' (only one): that is what 'direzione obbligatoria' means.

sceneParams.caption: The arrow = the only way allowed

q20071.en: The sign shown is a regulatory sign.

explain.short: Mandatory signs belong to the regulatory signs (prescrizione), together with prohibition signs.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (regulatory) covers both prohibitions and obligations.

q20072.en: The sign shown is a compulsory direction sign.

explain.short: Its name is 'direzione obbligatoria a sinistra': compulsory direction left.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'direzione obbligatoria' (compulsory direction): the arrow is an order.

q20073.en: The sign shown is a mandatory sign.

explain.short: It is a blue disc with a white arrow: blue discs give obligations.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' (obligation): blue round sign = you MUST do it.

q20074.en: The sign shown allows you to go straight on at the junction.

explain.short: You may only turn left, so going straight on is not allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'consente di andare diritto' (allows straight on) is the opposite of the sign.

q20075.en: The sign shown allows you to turn right at the junction.

explain.short: You may only turn left, so turning right is not allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'consente di svoltare a destra' (allows a right turn) is wrong: only left.

q20076.en: The sign shown indicates the start of one-way traffic after a left turn.

explain.short: It only orders a left turn; it says nothing about the road after the turn being one-way.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) has its own information sign; this is an obligation.

sceneParams.caption: Left only: says nothing about one-way

q20077.en: The sign shown indicates the end of two-way traffic after a right turn.

explain.short: It orders a LEFT turn and says nothing about two-way traffic.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'svolta a destra' is wrong twice: the arrow points left, and two-way traffic is not mentioned.

q20078.en: The sign shown means you must pass to the left of an obstacle on the carriageway.

explain.short: The arrow points straight to the left: turn left. The obstacle sign has a diagonal arrow pointing down-left.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'passare a sinistra di un ostacolo' is a different sign with a slanted arrow.

keywords.en: pass to the left of an obstacle

q20079.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: A blue disc gives an obligation; it does not just inform.

explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information) is wrong: this is an obligation sign.

q20080.en: The sign shown is a prohibition sign.

q20081.en: The sign shown indicates that the road you cross is one-way to the left.

explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) is told by a different, rectangular sign.

q20082.en: The sign shown indicates a parallel one-way street.

explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'senso unico parallelo' (one-way, side view) is a long rectangle, not a disc.

q20083.en: The sign shown indicates that you may only turn left.

explain.short: The arrow points left on a blue disc: left is the only allowed way.

q20084.en: The sign shown indicates that you may not continue straight on.

q20085.en: The sign shown indicates that turning left is forbidden.

explain.trap: 'divieto' (ban) is the opposite of 'obbligo': here left is compulsory.

q20086.en: The sign shown indicates that you may stop on the left side of the road.

explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.
explain.trap: 'fermare' (stop) has nothing to do with a compulsory direction arrow.

q20087.en: The sign shown means you must continue straight on.

explain.short: The arrow points left, not up: you must turn left.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a sinistra' (compulsory left) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the left. At the junction you may only turn left: no straight on, no right.

q20088.en: The sign shown means you must go around the obstacle on the left.

q20089.en: The sign shown means advance warning of a bend to the left.

q20093.en: The sign shown, placed before a junction, does not allow you to continue straight on.

explain.short: It is a blue disc with a white arrow: blue discs give obligations.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' (obligation): blue round sign = you MUST do it.

q20096.en: The sign shown is a compulsory direction sign.

explain.short: Its name is 'direzione obbligatoria a destra': compulsory direction right.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'direzione obbligatoria' (compulsory direction): the arrow is an order.

q20097.en: The sign shown indicates the only direction allowed.

explain.short: A compulsory direction sign shows the one and only way you may go: here, right.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'unica' (only one): that is what 'direzione obbligatoria' means.

sceneParams.caption: The arrow = the only way allowed

q20098.en: The sign shown indicates that turning right is dangerous.

explain.short: It is not a danger warning: it orders you to turn right. Danger signs are red triangles.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'pericoloso' (dangerous) belongs to triangle signs; a blue disc is an order.

sceneParams.caption: An order to turn right, not a danger

q20099.en: The sign shown requires you to continue straight on.

explain.short: The arrow points right, not up: you must turn right.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'prescrive di proseguire diritto' would need an arrow pointing up.

sceneParams.caption: Arrow right = turn right, not straight

q20100.en: The sign shown indicates the start of one-way traffic in the right turn.

explain.short: It only orders a right turn; it says nothing about a one-way street.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) has its own information sign; this is an obligation.

sceneParams.caption: Right only: says nothing about one-way

q20101.en: The sign shown indicates the end of two-way traffic in the left turn.

explain.short: It orders a RIGHT turn and says nothing about two-way traffic.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'svolta a sinistra' is wrong twice: the arrow points right, and two-way traffic is not mentioned.

q20102.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: A blue disc gives an obligation; it does not just inform.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information) is wrong: this is an obligation sign.

q20103.en: The sign shown is a prohibition sign.

explain.short: Prohibition signs have a red ring; this blue disc tells you what you must do.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'divieto' (prohibition) = red ring; blue disc = 'obbligo'.

sceneParams.caption: Blue = must do, red ring = must not

q20104.en: The sign shown indicates that the road you cross is one-way to the right.

explain.short: It only orders you to turn right; it does not say the crossing road is one-way.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) is told by a different, rectangular sign.

q20105.en: The sign shown indicates a parallel one-way street.

explain.short: A 'senso unico parallelo' is a rectangular information sign; this round blue sign orders a right turn.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'senso unico parallelo' (one-way, side view) is a long rectangle, not a disc.

q20106.en: The sign shown indicates compulsory direction right.

explain.short: It is exactly the sign 'direzione obbligatoria a destra': white arrow to the right on a blue disc.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'direzione obbligatoria' (compulsory direction): you must go that way.

q20107.en: The sign shown indicates that you may only turn right.

explain.short: The arrow points right on a blue disc: right is the only allowed way.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only): no other direction is allowed.

q20108.en: The sign shown indicates that you may not continue straight on.

explain.short: You must turn right, so going straight on is not allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' (is not allowed): straight on is excluded.

q20109.en: The sign shown indicates that you must turn right.

explain.short: A blue disc with an arrow to the right orders a right turn.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'si deve' (you must): it is an obligation, not a choice.

q20110.en: The sign shown indicates that turning right is forbidden.

explain.short: It is the opposite: a blue disc ORDERS the right turn. A ban would have a red ring and a crossed arrow.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'divieto' (ban) is the opposite of 'obbligo': here right is compulsory.

q20111.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area on the right.

explain.short: Parking is shown by a 'P' sign; this blue disc orders a right turn.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'parcheggio' (parking) has its own sign with a white P.

sceneParams.caption: Turn right, not a parking area

q20112.en: The sign shown means you must continue straight on.

explain.short: The arrow points right, not up: you must turn right.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'proseguire diritto' would need an arrow pointing up.

sceneParams.caption: Arrow right = turn right, not straight

q20113.en: The sign shown means you must pass to the right of the obstacle.

explain.short: The arrow is horizontal: turn right at the junction. The obstacle sign has a diagonal arrow pointing down-right.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'passare a destra dell'ostacolo' is a different sign with a slanted arrow.

keywords.en: pass to the right of the obstacle

q20114.en: The sign shown means advance warning of a bend to the right.

explain.short: Bends are warned by red triangles; this blue disc orders a right turn.
explain.rule: 'Direzione obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right) is a blue disc with a white arrow to the right. At the junction you may only turn right: no straight on, no left.
explain.trap: 'curva' (bend) is a danger sign, not an obligation sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not a bend: a compulsory right turn
